verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change remains correct and complete. `worker-prep.sh` rejects `claude-credentials-json` during initial format admission, before creating the worker tree or spooling the source credential, and `worker-live.sh` independently rejects it at the container-delivery seam. The Codex pre-flight no longer has an original-document fallback: both refresh and skip paths bind `mounted` to derived minimal material, and the serialized mount is checked unconditionally for the original refresh-token value. The new coverage is substantive: it proves the refused fixture contains the durable sentinel, requires an actionable refusal before any sentinel or mount material is written, retains a positive opaque-token control, exercises the expired-token skip path, and asserts the launcher's exact non-dying format set. I found no correctness, fail-closed, security, injection, or test-validity defect. Round 3 also had no findings, so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
